LEG_A_CpA_note: OPC contributes only 71 tested CpA bins (0 significant); the CpA stratum cannot test this question.
permutation_feasibility: The diagnosis-label permutation requested (>=1000 relabellings of ASD/control at the DONOR level, refitting the per-bin model each time) is NOT computable from any file on disk. `GSE298243_Age_DMRs_PrespecifiedRegions.tsv.gz` is a per-bin SUMMARY table: one row per (cell type x cytosine context x feature) carrying only fitted coefficients, SEs, p, q and the paper's significance flags. It holds no per-donor and no per-nucleus methylation values, no donor identifiers and no diagnosis column, so the label to be permuted does not exist in it and the model cannot be refit. Permuting the significance flag across bins instead would test a different null and is not done here. **What would be needed:** the GSE298243 genotype-masked pseudo-bulk per-donor ALLC files (CGN and CAN, one pair per donor x cell type, described in `GSE298243_README.docx`) plus the donor metadata table carrying diagnosis/age/RIN, which together allow the per-bin mC/C model to be refit under permuted labels. Per-cell-type NUCLEI COUNTS - the quantity E-006's 'OPC is rare -> fewest nuclei -> noisiest' premise turns on - live in the supplementary Seurat object's metadata slot, also not downloaded. **What is run instead, and labelled as a different null:** a CELL-TYPE-label permutation, unstratified and stratified within coefSE deciles, which answers 'is OPC's significant-bin count what an SE-matched random draw of the same number of pooled tested bins would give?' - the null the artifact hypothesis asserts.

build_verification.interpretation: The shipped Symbol for FeatureType=='gene' rows is often an Ensembl ID or a small-RNA/pseudogene/lncRNA name that RefSeq refGene does not carry, so the unconditional match rate understates agreement. Conditioning on the shipped symbol existing in refGene at all is the right build check: a high conditional rate means the coordinates are hg38.

_legs.a_noise: FAILS as an explanation. Within SE deciles the significant-bin rate FALLS monotonically with SE (others: 0.0409 in decile 1 -> 0.0080 in decile 10), the opposite of the mechanism E-006 proposed; matching on SE decile RAISES the OPC OR from 1.92 to 2.86 (95% CI 2.50-3.29, p=4e-56). The excess is also present at every fixed p-value threshold and grows with stringency (crude OR 1.19 at p<0.05 -> 1.54 at p<1e-4; SE-matched 1.25 -> 2.35), so it is not an artifact of the paper's FDR procedure either.
_legs.b_region: STANDS as a limitation, and is the binding one. Only 2103 of 124166 unique CpG features are shared by any pair of cell types (449 shared bins summed over all 7 OPC-vs-X pairs), because every row of this file is an age-DMR OF THAT CELL TYPE (ReportSignif_Age is '*' on 100.0% of rows), so the eight cell types are compared on essentially disjoint region sets. MH stratified on FeatureType gives OR 1.93 and on SE decile x FeatureType 3.01, so the coarse region covariates the table supports do not explain the excess - but they are coarse, and the disjointness itself cannot be adjusted away with this file.
_legs.c_emptiness: FAILS AS STATED, but its conclusion survives on better evidence. Only 2.24% of OPC's TESTED CpG features carry a gene symbol, so 6.1 symbol-carrying bins are expected among the 272 significant ones and 3 were observed (binomial p=0.30): 3/272 is the expected number and measures the file's annotation sparsity, not the signal. Coordinate mapping against a local hg38 refGene raises annotated coverage from 2.24% to 75.7% (206 of 272 significant bins map, hitting 205 distinct genes) and still finds NO module enrichment against the coordinate-mapped OPC background (every BH q > 0.66, including SFARI OR 0.67 and the positive-control OL-maturation and lipid modules) - so 'no nameable mechanism' stands, for a better reason than E-006 gave.

_bottom_line: The OPC excess is NOT an estimator-noise artifact and NOT mechanistically empty in the way E-006 claimed - SE-decile matching raises the OR from 1.92 to 2.86 (95% CI 2.50-3.29, p=4e-56) and 3/272 gene symbols is exactly what the 2.24% annotation rate of the tested background predicts - but it remains UNDECIDABLE as a claim about cell types, because every row of this file is an age-DMR of its own cell type, so the eight tested bin sets are near-disjoint (2103 of 124166 unique CpG features shared by any pair) and 'OPC has the highest rate' is a statement about OPC's own age-DMR set, not about a common genomic yardstick; deciding it needs the GSE298243 per-donor pseudo-bulk ALLC files + donor metadata (to refit a common bin set and permute diagnosis labels), which are not on disk.
